environment.description: ECS Fargate task running on platform version 1.4.0 with awsvpc networking mode. Container runs as root (uid 0) with default Docker seccomp profile. Task role has no restrictions on outbound network. Health check port 8080 is exposed to the VPC via the task's ENI with no network ACL restrictions on intra-VPC traffic. No sidecar proxy or service mesh configured.
